description: Offline spoken-English sentence bank for fill-in-the-blank practice. Authored for Desktop Vocabulary Coach.

sentences.grammarNote: favor 作名词，do sb a favor 是口语里最常用的“帮个忙”表达。

sentences.sentence: I can't ____ to buy a new car right now.
sentences.grammarNote: afford 后接 to do，表示“负担得起做某事”。

sentences.sentence: Can I ____ your phone for a minute?
sentences.translationZh: 我能借你的手机用一下吗？
sentences.grammarNote: borrow 是“借入”，borrow sth from sb；lend 是“借出”。
lend sb sth = 把某物借给某人；borrow 是向别人借入。

sentences.sentence: Please ____ me to call the doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 请提醒我给医生打电话。
sentences.grammarNote: remind sb to do sth = 提醒某人做某事；remember 是“自己记得”。
forget to do 表示“忘记去做”；forget doing 表示“忘记做过”。
Would you mind doing...? 是委婉请求，mind 后接动名词。
would rather do sth = 宁愿做某事，后面直接跟动词原形。
had better do sth = 最好做某事，后面跟动词原形，不接 to。
主语 it 是第三人称单数，动词用 depends；depend on = 取决于。

sentences.sentence: I ____ two hours on this report yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我昨天在这份报告上花了两个小时。
sentences.grammarNote: spend 的过去式是 spent；spend time on sth = 在某事上花时间。
cost 的主语是物，句型是 sth costs sb money；过去式仍是 cost。

sentences.sentence: It ____ me an hour to get to work.
sentences.translationZh: 我上班路上要花一个小时。
sentences.pattern: It takes sb time to do sth
sentences.grammarNote: It takes sb + 时间 + to do sth 是固定句型；主语 it 用 takes。
pay for sth = 为某物付款；spend 的主语是人，cost 的主语是物。

sentences.sentence: I'll call you later to ____ up.
sentences.translationZh: 我晚点打电话跟你聊聊近况。
sentences.grammarNote: catch up = 叙旧、了解近况，口语里很常用。

sentences.sentence: I can't ____ out how to use this app.
sentences.translationZh: 我搞不懂这个 App 怎么用。
sentences.grammarNote: figure out = 弄明白、想出，后面可以接从句。

sentences.sentence: Do you want to ____ out this weekend?
sentences.translationZh: 这周末想一起出去玩吗？
sentences.grammarNote: hang out = 一起消磨时间、出去玩，是非常口语的表达。
give up = 放弃；后面接动名词时表示放弃做某事。
run out of = 用完；现在完成时 have + 过去分词，run 的过去分词仍是 run。

sentences.sentence: Don't ____ off until tomorrow what you can do today.
sentences.translationZh: 今天能做的事不要拖到明天。
sentences.grammarNote: put off = 推迟；put off doing sth = 推迟做某事。

sentences.sentence: It ____ out that he was right.
sentences.grammarNote: turn out = 结果是；这里用过去式 turned，后接 that 从句。
end up doing sth = 最终做了某事；end 用过去式 ended。

sentences.sentence: I need to ____ up for lost time.
sentences.translationZh: 我得把失去的时间补回来。
sentences.grammarNote: make up for sth = 弥补某事；for 后面接名词或动名词。

sentences.sentence: I'm looking forward to ____ from you.
sentences.grammarNote: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 hearing。

sentences.sentence: I'm not ____ to getting up early.
sentences.grammarNote: be used to doing = 习惯于做某事；used to do 则是“过去常常”。

sentences.sentence: How do you ____ along with your coworkers?
sentences.translationZh: 你和同事相处得怎么样？
sentences.grammarNote: get along with sb = 与某人相处；how 疑问句用助动词 do。

sentences.sentence: I hope you can ____ up with a better idea.
sentences.translationZh: 希望你能想出一个更好的主意。
sentences.grammarNote: come up with sth = 想出、提出；can 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: Could you ____ care of my cat this weekend?
sentences.translationZh: 这周末你能帮我照顾猫吗？
sentences.grammarNote: take care of = 照顾；Could you 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: I'll ____ you up at the airport.
sentences.grammarNote: pick sb up = 开车接某人；代词要放在 pick 和 up 中间。

sentences.sentence: Can you ____ me off at the station?
sentences.grammarNote: drop sb off = 开车把某人送到某处；与 pick up 相对。

sentences.sentence: We need to ____ in before 3 p.m.
sentences.translationZh: 我们需要在下午 3 点前办理入住。
sentences.grammarNote: check in = 办理入住/登机手续；need to 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: It took me a week to ____ over the cold.
sentences.translationZh: 我花了一周才从感冒中恢复。
sentences.grammarNote: get over sth = 从疾病/打击中恢复；to 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: My car ____ down on the highway.
sentences.translationZh: 我的车在高速上抛锚了。
sentences.grammarNote: break down = 出故障；break 的过去式是 broke。

sentences.sentence: Don't ____ up that topic at dinner.
sentences.grammarNote: bring up = 提起（话题）；Don't 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: They had to ____ off the meeting.
sentences.grammarNote: call off = 取消；had to 后接动词原形。
carry on with sth = 继续做某事；也可以直接说 carry on。

sentences.translationZh: 我会弄清楚发生了什么。
sentences.grammarNote: find out = 查明、弄清楚；后接宾语从句。
show up = 出现、到场；didn't 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: I hope this plan will ____ out.
sentences.grammarNote: work out = 顺利、成功；will 后接动词原形。
write down = 写下；代词可放在 write 和 down 中间。

sentences.sentence: I'm going to ____ for that job.
sentences.grammarNote: apply for a job = 申请工作；be going to 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: I don't ____ with you on this.
sentences.translationZh: 在这件事上我不同意你。
sentences.grammarNote: agree with sb = 同意某人；agree to sth = 同意某事。
apologize for sth/doing sth = 为某事道歉；should 后接动词原形。
主语 he 是第三人称单数，用 complains；complain about = 抱怨。

sentences.sentence: Don't ____ about things you can't control.
sentences.translationZh: 别为无法控制的事情担心。
sentences.grammarNote: worry about sth = 担心某事；Don't 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence: I don't ____ what other people think.
sentences.grammarNote: care 可以接 about，也可以直接接 what 从句；don't 后接原形。

sentences.sentence: I can't ____ on my work with this noise.
sentences.translationZh: 这么吵我没法专心工作。
sentences.grammarNote: concentrate on sth = 专注于某事；can't 后接动词原形。
rely on sb = 依靠某人；can 后接动词原形。
主语 this book 是第三人称单数，用 belongs；belong to = 属于。

sentences.sentence: The rain ____ us from going out.
sentences.grammarNote: prevent sb from doing sth = 阻止某人做某事；这里用过去式 prevented。
succeed in doing sth = 成功做某事；succeed 的过去式是 succeeded。
主语 he 是第三人称单数，用 suffers；suffer from = 受……困扰。
insist on doing sth = 坚持做某事；这里用过去式 insisted。

sentences.sentence: I want to ____ you on your new job.
sentences.translationZh: 我想恭喜你找到新工作。
sentences.grammarNote: congratulate sb on sth = 祝贺某人某事；want to 后接动词原形。
improve 直接接宾语，不需要加 in；want to 后接动词原形。
yesterday 表示过去，go 的过去式是 went。

sentences.pattern: 一般现在时第三人称单数
sentences.grammarNote: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，go 变为 goes。
be going to do sth 表示计划或预测；I'm 后接 going。
have + 过去分词；see 的过去分词是 seen。
Have you + 过去分词；eat 的过去分词是 eaten。
have + 过去分词；do 的过去分词是 done。

sentences.translationZh: 我今天上午写了三封邮件。
sentences.grammarNote: I've = I have，后接过去分词；write 的过去分词是 written。
Have you + 过去分词；speak 的过去分词是 spoken。

sentences.pattern: be + 过去分词作形容词
sentences.grammarNote: broken 是 break 的过去分词，这里作形容词表示“坏了的”。
表示“人感兴趣”用 interested；interesting 用来形容事物。

sentences.translationZh: 我对这个游戏感到无聊。
sentences.grammarNote: 人感到无聊用 bored；boring 表示“令人无聊的”。

sentences.translationZh: 我们对这次旅行很兴奋。
sentences.grammarNote: 人感到兴奋用 excited；exciting 表示“令人兴奋的”。
人感到惊讶用 surprised；surprising 表示“令人惊讶的”。
tired 表示“感到累的”；too ... to ... 表示“太……而不能……”。
形容事物“令人放松”用 relaxing；relaxed 表示“人感到放松”。
